summary.business_type: Local web design agency (service-area business), Veendam, Netherlands
top_findings: No trust anchors (years active, project count, guarantee, reviews, images) on any of the 30 city/branche pages, while ranking competitors lead with exactly this
No phone number, KvK, or BTW number published anywhere on the site
Homepage LCP measures 7.9s (Poor), caused by ~900KB largely-unused JS and 106KB render-blocking CSS, not the well-optimized hero image
45 of 47 pages render zero images despite a reusable ExampleSlideshow component already existing
Mobile cookie-consent reject button renders almost entirely off-screen and is effectively untappable
quick_wins: Add /website-checker to the sitemap (already live, linked, just missing from the list)
Remove deprecated HowTo schema from 6 pages (Google retired HowTo rich results in 2023)
Enable gzip/brotli + HTTP/2 in nginx (config-only, no code change)
Fix mobile cookie-banner CSS so all buttons are reachable
Add a concrete starting price figure to the pricing paragraph on all 15 branche pages

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: All 47 sitemap URLs return clean 200s with unique canonical/title/description and one H1
Confirmed true SSR — content readable without JS execution
Security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, etc.) all present
Custom 404 with correct noindex; redirect consolidation works for common cases

findings.title: Static JS/CSS assets served with no compression at all
findings.description: ~1.05MB of JS+CSS transferred uncompressed despite client advertising gzip/br support; HTML itself IS compressed, so this is an nginx config gap for the /assets/ location block.
findings.recommendation: Enable gzip/brotli for application/javascript and text/css in nginx, or serve pre-compressed .gz/.br sidecars via gzip_static.

findings.title: No HTTP/2 support
findings.description: ALPN negotiates HTTP/1.1 only; ~20 modulepreloaded JS chunks compete over a handful of HTTP/1.1 connections.
findings.recommendation: Enable HTTP/2 (or HTTP/3) in the nginx listen directive — one-line config change.

findings.title: Homepage still missing FAQPage structured data live
findings.description: Code calls faqJsonLd() on the homepage route but live HTML shows only 2 JSON-LD blocks, no FAQPage — code/deploy mismatch.
findings.recommendation: Verify deploy includes the change; check for a TanStack Router head-merging issue dropping the route's scripts array.

findings.title: Duplicate/redundant HTTP response headers
findings.description: Several security/cache headers are sent twice (once lowercase, once mixed-case), indicating they're set at two layers (nginx and app middleware).
findings.recommendation: Set each header in exactly one place; merge duplicate Cache-Control directives into one.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: City and branche pages are genuinely unique, non-templated (re-verified on a fresh sample)
LocationLanding.tsx duplicate-content risk confirmed resolved (dead code, no route imports it)
Honest, transparent fixed pricing with no hidden-fee language
No keyword stuffing found anywhere sampled

findings.title: Contact page has no phone, address, or KVK/BTW
findings.description: /contact carries only 72 words: a pitch, a booking link, and an email address — no verifiable business identity details.
findings.recommendation: Add a visible phone number, KVK number, and BTW number to /contact and the site footer.

findings.title: Homepage and /over-ons are too thin for their role
findings.description: Homepage is 303 words and does not appear to render FAQ content in extractable text; /over-ons is 206 words with no checkable specifics.
findings.recommendation: Expand both pages with concrete, checkable details rather than generic copy.

findings.title: Branche-page pricing remains generic
findings.description: Re-verified live on a second branche page (bloemist, not just the original kapsalon sample) — no euro figure appears in the pricing paragraph despite /tarieven stating concrete numbers.
findings.recommendation: Open each branche page's pricing paragraph with a concrete anchor figure consistent with /tarieven.

findings.title: No reviews, testimonials, or external validation anywhere
findings.description: Unchanged since the prior audit — confirmed still absent on a fresh live check.
findings.recommendation: Collect real Google reviews post-delivery; never fabricate testimonials.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Single canonical ORG_ID entity with no duplicate @id conflicts across any sampled page
LocalBusiness schema only on the one real location (Veendam); other city pages correctly use Service + areaServed
BreadcrumbList implemented on 45 of 53 routes
No fabricated Review/AggregateRating schema anywhere

findings.title: Deprecated HowTo schema live on 6 pages
findings.description: Google removed HowTo rich results in September 2023; the schema is now dead weight on onderhoud-hosting, seo, webshop-laten-maken, website-laten-maken, website-laten-vernieuwen, and werkwijze routes.
findings.recommendation: Remove howToJsonLd() calls from all 6 routes.

findings.title: Homepage FAQPage schema in code but not rendering live
findings.description: index.tsx calls faqJsonLd(faqItems), but live raw and Playwright-rendered fetches both show only 2 JSON-LD blocks, no FAQPage.
findings.recommendation: Confirm deploy includes the change; investigate head-merging behavior.

categories.name: Sitemap
what_works: All 47 URLs return 200 with no redirects/404s/noindex
Robots.txt-disallowed paths correctly excluded
Internal cross-linking between city and branche pages now fixed — click depth 1 from homepage to any leaf page

findings.title: /website-checker missing from sitemap
findings.description: A real, linked, indexable tool page (full meta tags, own BreadcrumbList schema, linked from homepage Hero and site nav) is absent from the hardcoded sitemap entry list.
findings.recommendation: Add /website-checker to the entries array in src/routes/sitemap[.]xml.tsx.

categories.name: Performance (Core Web Vitals)
what_works: TTFB excellent everywhere (33-90ms)
CLS excellent (0.00016) — no layout-shift risk
Render-blocking limited to a single CSS file

findings.title: Homepage LCP and FCP both Poor
findings.description: LCP 7,855ms, FCP 7,405ms — 92% of LCP time is render delay, not network. The actual LCP element is hero text, not the well-optimized hero image.
findings.recommendation: Ensure the hero text is visible immediately in SSR HTML without JS-gated animation delay; reduce total blocking JS/CSS weight.

findings.title: Site-wide JS bundle ~900KB with 55-71% unused, shared by every template
findings.description: Main bundle 695KB (61% unused), motion/react 124KB (55% unused), Radix 53KB (71% unused) — confirmed loaded identically across all templates.
findings.recommendation: Run a bundle visualizer, lazy-load below-fold motion/react usages, audit Radix imports for barrel-import waste.

findings.title: 106KB render-blocking CSS
findings.description: Single CSS file estimated to cost 3.15s of blocking time.
findings.recommendation: Extract critical above-the-fold CSS inline; load the rest asynchronously.

categories.name: Images / Visual
what_works: Homepage and /website-laten-maken deliver a labeled example-project mockup with a working carousel
No document-level horizontal scroll on any tested page

findings.title: 45 of 47 pages render zero images
findings.description: Branche and city template pages are confirmed pure text (imgCount: 0), producing a visually thin, less-trustworthy experience versus competitors showing real project work.
findings.recommendation: Reuse the existing ExampleSlideshow component on branche/city pages.

findings.title: Mobile cookie-consent reject button clipped off-screen
findings.description: At 390px viewport, the 'Alleen noodzakelijk' button has only ~2px of 153px width inside the visible area — effectively untappable.
findings.recommendation: Make the cookie banner full-width or centered with adequate margins below ~480px viewports.

findings.title: Mobile tap targets under recommended minimum size
findings.description: Nav 'Contact' pill measures 91x38px (below 44-48px height guideline); cookie 'Aanpassen' link is 63x16px.
findings.recommendation: Increase padding on mobile nav button and cookie customize link.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO)
what_works: robots.txt explicitly allows GPTBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, OAI-SearchBot
llms.txt already exists and is well-structured
Confirmed full SSR delivery to a GPTBot user-agent with no JS dependency
Concrete, repeated facts (€499, 2-4 weken, Veendam) are exactly the kind of quotable data AI answer engines cite

findings.title: Zero real case studies or client results anywhere
findings.description: Work.tsx contains fictional portfolio data and is not rendered anywhere on the site — the single biggest citability/EEAT gap for AI answer engines, which favor verifiable outcomes over generic process copy.
findings.recommendation: Build a real cases section once client permission and results exist.

findings.title: Answer blocks too long and not self-contained for citation
findings.description: Good facts exist but are buried in multi-sentence paragraphs that reference UI elements ('de knop hierboven'), not extractable as standalone 40-60 word answers.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite opening sentences of each content block as self-contained answers; remove UI-dependent references.

findings.title: No multi-modal content
findings.description: Branche/city pages have zero images; only one comparison table exists site-wide (/tarieven).
findings.recommendation: Add a small fact-block or comparison table (starting price, delivery time, what's included) to each branche/city page.

categories.name: Search Experience (SXO)
what_works: Correct page-type selection for every query checked — no critical structural mismatches
Consistent, working CTAs on every sampled page
FAQPage schema + OfferCatalog on /tarieven directly targets pricing-query intent

findings.title: City pages lack every Local Page trust anchor competitors lead with
findings.description: Ranking competitors lead with '10+ jaar ervaring', '1000+ websites', '100% garantie' and price-anchored titles; AIMI's city pages have none of this plus zero images and no LocalBusiness/NAP/map block.
findings.recommendation: Add a checkable trust line (founding year, if accurate) plus a visible service-area/contact block to all 15 city pages.

findings.title: /tarieven answers 'what AIMI charges' not 'what a website costs' (the actual query intent)
findings.description: Ranking content for this query is structured as a market comparison (freelancer rates, platform costs); AIMI only shows its own three tiers.
findings.recommendation: Add a short market-range section alongside the existing AIMI-specific pricing table.

findings.title: Zero visual proof on every niche and local page sampled
findings.description: parse_html.py returned images: [] for 6 of 12 pages sampled (all branche/city pages checked).
findings.recommendation: Reuse ExampleSlideshow on the highest-traffic branche and city pages.

categories.name: Local SEO
what_works: Service-area business correctly modeled — LocalBusiness schema only on the one real location (Veendam)
Dedicated, genuinely unique service-area pages for all 15 cities — the #1 local ranking factor per Whitespark
No fabricated reviews or AggregateRating — correct restraint

findings.title: No telephone number anywhere on the public site
findings.description: No tel: link, no telephone property in any schema block. Risks silently mismatching the linked GBP profile.
findings.recommendation: Publish a real business phone/WhatsApp number consistently, or confirm GBP also omits one.

findings.title: No KvK number, BTW number, or registered business address disclosed
findings.description: Neither legal page nor footer discloses these for AIMI itself — a trust gap and a barrier to automated directory verification.
findings.recommendation: Add KvK/BTW number to the footer or legal pages.

findings.title: Review velocity is zero — full '18-day rule' exposure
findings.description: No Review/AggregateRating schema and no testimonial widget anywhere; review signals are ~16-20% of local ranking weight.
findings.recommendation: Collect 3-5 real reviews before adding any rating schema.

findings.title: Domain not found in the Common Crawl web graph
findings.description: Consistent with a genuinely young, low-authority domain rather than a tooling gap — not provable as 'zero links' but real evidence of an unestablished footprint.
findings.recommendation: Re-run this check quarterly; treat citation-building as a prerequisite to backlink-building.

findings.title: Only one external citation (Google Maps) in site schema
findings.description: No LinkedIn, Facebook, or directory URL appears anywhere in the sameAs array.
findings.recommendation: Create a LinkedIn Company Page at minimum and add it to sameAs.

findings.title: Untapped client-footer-credit link opportunity
findings.description: AIMI builds client sites, a structurally legitimate low-cost link acquisition channel not yet verified as used.
findings.recommendation: Compile delivered client domains and check/request 'website door AIMI' footer credits.
